## Highlights

- **Windows no longer needs the Visual C++ redistributable.**
  The C runtime is now linked statically, so `rustinel.exe` starts on a clean Windows install instead of exiting silently with `STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND`.
  The release build now checks the binary's import table to keep it that way.
- **Dependency security fixes.**
  yara-x moves to 1.22.1 and the lockfile is bumped to clear the open RustSec advisories.

## Upgrade notes

- **Release candidate:** install `1.11.0-rc.2` explicitly with the installer version option.
  `rustinel update` follows stable releases.
  Restart the service after replacing the binary, then run `rustinel doctor` and verify a known detection before broad deployment.
- This candidate carries everything in the [1.11.0-rc.1 notes](1.11.0-rc.1.md).
